title: Herbed Crunchy Indian Cabbage Salad
description: A sour, crunchy Mangalorean salad featuring shredded white cabbage, toasted cumin and coriander, fresh mint, cilantro and a bright lemon mustard oil dressing.
instructions: Wash and shred 500g of white cabbage into fine ribbons.
Toast 1/2 tsp cumin seeds and 1 tsp coriander seeds in a dry pan until fragrant, then transfer to a bowl.
Add 1 tbsp chopped fresh mint, 1 tbsp chopped cilantro, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper to the toasted seeds and mix.
Pour 1 tbsp mustard oil over the spice mix and stir until the oil is fully incorporated.
Add the shredded cabbage to a large bowl and pour the prepared spice‑oil mixture over it.
Drizzle 2 tbsp lemon juice across the salad and toss thoroughly to coat evenly.
Let the salad rest for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature, optionally garnished with extra mint or cilantro.
